overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating peer review comments using both automated metrics and human evaluation. It addresses NLG evaluation through the assessment of review comments. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and removal of venue names incorrectly listed as datasets. The paper uses LLMs both for generation (creating synthetic data) and as judges (evaluating review comments), but Question 3 specifically focuses on the LLM-as-judge aspect.
